fable2_recomp_macos.scope: backends/metal of that repository: port/, compat.h, xenia_helpers.h, metal_flags.*, plugin_main.cpp, shaders/, third_party/, tools/msl_xlate_tool.cc, tools/compile_metal_helpers.py (adapted), the sdk-metal*.patch series and src/diagnostics/fable2_trace_api.h

xenios.scope: Adapted Metal/UI sources under port; built-in helper shader source downloaded at build time

rexglue.scope: Fable II adapted the graphics sources of this commit. In this tree the shared, additive hunks (xenos.h, texture/info.h, the inline bit_scan_forward in math.h) are committed to the SDK itself; the rest of the sdk-metal*.patch series is applied at configure time to a private copy of the graphics sources that only rexgpu-metal compiles. Graphics sources are unchanged between that commit and v0.10.1.

original_work: ReXGlue compatibility adapters and plugin integration, register batching, geometry retry backoff, selective Metal readback/completion handling, build scripts and tests.
distribution: Source only; no generated guest code, game-derived shaders, game files, saves or compiled dependencies included.
